sourceFrame: ICRS/J2000 and published SDSS survey Cartesian
distanceConvention: Comoving Mpc/h retained by source-specific cosmology
redshiftConvention: SDSS CMB-frame redshift where published; BOSS catalog redshift
cosmologyAssumption: Tempel: Ωm=0.27, ΩΛ=0.73; Mao voids: flat Ωm=0.3
knownLimitations: The galaxy layer is a deterministic one-in-twelve LOD sample of 576,493 source galaxies.
The filament layer deploys the 2,306 catalog filaments at least 15 Mpc/h long, not all 15,421 filaments.
Filaments and voids are observation-based reconstructions, not directly imaged structures.
Void effective-radius rings are representative volume-equivalent markers, not measured physical boundaries.
Survey masks, flux limits, redshift limits and source cosmologies remain visible limitations; unobserved regions are not filled.
Walls are unavailable as a separately validated deployed geometry.
